sentences.back: Leo pushed his blue bicycle out of the garage, ready for the afternoon outing.
Before setting off, he fastened his helmet securely, realizing that safety is always most important whenever you ride.
As he pushed off the ground and started riding toward the neighborhood park, the afternoon sun cast long shadows on the sidewalks of the block.
Taking the familiar route required concentrating on steering, especially near the busy intersection where vehicles often pass.
Leo signaled his turn clearly and stopped at the crosswalk to make sure the road was completely clear.
After crossing the road safely, he sped down the gentle slope leading to the park entrance.
On arrival, he parked his bike beside the big oak tree and locked the frame firmly.
The park was full of lively sounds of children laughing and playing on the swings.
Leo took a deep breath of fresh air, glad he had come by bike, then walked over to sit on the grass with his friends.
